_comment: The published-spec-derived CALIBRATION slice for RealWorld/Conduit (plan-005 U7, R4). Each scenario carries a `reference` verdict DERIVED FROM THE PUBLISHED SPEC (not our inference) — the independent ground truth the grader's own verdict is Gauge-R&R'd against. The pre-screen (Approach): execute the slice once against the pinned implementation, hand-adjudicate every spec/implementation divergence, and mark deviating behaviors `screen: exclude` with a rationale so TARGET error never lands in the grader's calibration number (the Gauge-R&R denominator is the screened set only). Re-pinning the implementation re-runs the pre-screen — a recorded apparatus migration, not an edit. Offline, tests/test_e2e_scale.py synthesizes the target observation per scenario and grades it with grading.scenarios.check_post_assertion (the real deterministic grader primitive), then quantifies grader-vs-spec agreement.
spec_source: https://github.com/gothinkster/realworld (the RealWorld API + frontend spec; Conduit reference implementation)

scenarios.title: The global feed lists published articles

post_assertion.name: Calibrating a grader against a published spec

scenarios.screen_rationale: Spec: the home page Global Feed lists articles newest-first; the implementation matches.

scenarios.title: Opening an article shows its title

post_assertion.name: Calibrating a grader against a published spec

scenarios.screen_rationale: Spec: the article page renders the article body under its title heading; the implementation matches.

scenarios.title: The sign-in page is reachable
scenarios.screen_rationale: Spec: an unauthenticated user can reach the Sign in form; the implementation matches.

scenarios.title: The popular-tags sidebar lists seeded tags
scenarios.screen_rationale: Spec: the home sidebar lists popular tags as filter links; the implementation matches.

scenarios.title: Nested comment replies are NOT supported
scenarios.screen_rationale: Spec: comments are a flat list — nested/threaded replies are explicitly out of scope, so a faithful grader checking for a reply control must return fail. The implementation correctly lacks it.

scenarios.title: Emoji reactions on articles are NOT supported
scenarios.screen_rationale: Spec: articles support favorites only, never emoji reactions — an unsupported feature a faithful grader returns fail on. The implementation correctly lacks it.

scenarios.title: Article date renders in the spec's long format
scenarios.screen_rationale: PRE-SCREEN DIVERGENCE: the spec shows article dates in 'Month D, YYYY' format, but this pinned implementation renders ISO 8601 ('2024-01-01'). The grader cannot match the spec-derived node, but the miss is a TARGET deviation, not a grader fault — excluded from the Gauge-R&R denominator (R4).

scenarios.title: The feed offers numbered pagination controls
scenarios.screen_rationale: PRE-SCREEN DIVERGENCE: the spec specifies numbered pagination (page links 1, 2, 3…), but this pinned implementation uses infinite scroll and renders no page-number links. A TARGET deviation, not a grader fault — excluded from the Gauge-R&R denominator (R4).
